I'm naked and I'm walking the blue-painted halls at military academy, and it's okay because everyone gets hazed like this and I'm in better shape than all of them so I'm not ashamed, except this means they can see the scars twining from my back and down to my knees like snakes, and what starts as laughter turns into confused whispering and sounds of pity as they realize how recently I was a slave, and I want to kill them slowly just like I did the man who gave me the scars, but I just walk on, seeing only red.

He promised we would go to the beach on my birthday, so we went, even though it was raining, even though we didn't know where mom was again. I was collecting shells, and I found one that was perfect and round and smooth but then I looked back to the shore and saw him just standing there, the first time I'd ever seen him cry, and I wanted to say something but couldn't, just stood there, frozen, the shell crunching in my fist, and I looked down and my hand was bleeding but I didn't feel it at all.

They called me to identify the body, and I told them she divorced me last year but they didn't care because she had no friends, no family on the planet at all. I went in and they pulled back the sheet and she was there beautiful like she was asleep, and my full name was carved delicately into her left arm like calligraphy, the blood dried like rust on parchment. Every time I closed my eyes for a full year after I saw that. I still miss her.

"You have failed your family," he tells me with gentleness I know he's incapable of feeling. "You have dishonored us. You know what to do." And I know that the honorable thing is to fall on my sword like a good girl, so I take it out and push it through his chest and show him exactly what I think of his precious honor. I will never have to apologize again.

Upon warpin there is a Stasis Tower and 12-15 enemies in 3 or 4 smaller groups of mixed size and types. When you approach the tower will web you and all soldiers will aggress:

Later waves of soldiers similar in composition to the previous waves will warpin at a fair distance of 30kms or more. Each wave is triggered by the last ship in the preceding wave.There will be many DED soldiers - about 50-60 in the mission - arriving in four waves of 12-15 ships.

1st class DED soldiers represent the biggest threat with the shortest range (7 500m) weapons. 2nd and 3rd class soldiers are less of a threat and fire from a longer range (10 000m). All soldiers are clustered in groups (about 3 or 4 groups of varying size) per wave. Attack groups separately to try and avoid allowing them to gang up on you.

Until the tower is destroyed warping out is your only defence if you are swamped by the enemy. Drawing the soldiers away from the tower is the first step, then blowing up the tower is the next step. Once the tower is destroyed kill further waves of reinforcements.
Take them out group by group, and don't get nervous when new enemy warpins are triggered. New enemy warpins will be at distance, so try and keep the groups separated. Have a survivable setup.

The 2nd Spawn (4th pocket) deals high incoming damage (compared to all previous spawns in this mission), so be full on cap and hp before triggering it, although it is far away (102- 108km) and may be sniped before causing much damage.
In the 3rd Pocket, the spawn is of the same faction as the initial pocket spawn's Battleships.
In the 4th Pocket, the spawn's faction is based on the 1st group's faction, if Guristas, then the spawn will be Blood Raider, if Angels then Serpentis.
Bring a Gate Key and use the gate.
Use an afterburner, burn through each pocket, and pop maybe one high value BS on the way.
Kill Anire Scarlet in the last pocket for 5 mil bounty and head home. That's 10 to 11 mil for maybe 15 minutes play.
If you manage to alpha Scarlet twice, you will not even have to go to the last pocket.
Bring an extra Gate Key for convenience (and for each Fleet Member that is not warping at the same time).

en: 5 Visible groups in this stage. Left, Right, Top, Bottom and Back. No aggro on warp in but attack aggro varies, explained below.
Attacking left group causes aggro from the back group
Attacking right group causes aggro from the bottom group
1) Fire on the bottom group to get aggro from 3 groups. Different groups may aggro but the strength is the same.
Amarr Navy Jakars deal a lot of damage and tank very strongly with EM being the lowest resist at 50%.
The Sentries will only fire on you if you get close to them (Around 30-40km).
If you can, kill the frigs while they approach with their MWDs active.

Otherwise consider: All Interceptors orbit between 3000 m and 6300 m, thus Smartbombs can be used to destroy them quickly, but faction ones (e.g. Imperial Navy Large EMP Smartbomb) are required to eliminate all interceptors. Tech 1 large smartbombs do not have enough for this job. Drones work fine but the number of interceptors in the third pocket is rather high.
2) The mission objective (Amarr Light Marines) is dropped by the last ship of the back group.

3) The proper way to do this mission safely is to attack the LEFT group first, but this is tricky to do unless you have the range to attack them without approaching - the low group has proximity aggro around 50km (?) which means neither you, your buddies or your drones can get too close

to them. Anyway, attacking the left group agroes the back group as well, and that group contains the mission objective. Start heading away with as good speed as you can and downing frigates with guns, and drones when the enemy is beyond agro range of the low group. This is best done with a sniper fit (i.e. able to hit for good damage beyond 50 km). You can then attack the other groups if you want to (or not, to "blitz").
4) When doing the mission in a Tengu, be sure to kill the Frigs first and be sure to have a decent 10mn AB equiped so you can speedtank most of the larger ships.

Initially at the warp-in there is an acceleration gate and a stationary SOE Rescue Vessel. There are no hostiles.

Pocket One consists of no hostiles two cans: one labeled Minmatar Embassy Housing, one labeled Amarr Embassy Housing and an Acceleration Gate to Pocket 2. Shortly after warping in you are given a message that you can only save one.

Pick up the embassy staff from one of the housing cans, and the other blows up. Contrary to the mission advice, you do not seem to lose faction standing for the faction that you leave behind, or receive any improvements if you rescue one or both.

Note: It is possible to rescue both diplomats at once, but it will require a fleet and proper timing. Once you rescue one, you will have only a few seconds to rescue the second before the embassy building explodes, so you'll need a second pilot at the other embassy to grab the other diplomat at the same time you do. Either way, an opposing fleet will be present at the destination of the second gate (ie, the mission entrance) following your rescue. A third pilot with a well-tanked battleship can withstand the enemy fleet while other pilots complete the drop-off.

There is an acceleration gate here that returns to the warp-in/mission entrance and it will place you at 50km from the container, but if you prefer it is possible to warp out and then warp back to the mission.

In addition to the SOE Rescue Vessel present when you first warped-in, you now have faction ships of the faction you didn't save out for your blood (See list below), but you do not have to kill them to complete the mission. Ships will vary depending on which empire space you are in.
There is no reason to take the gate as it will simply return you to P1. The mission is complete once the diplomatic staff are placed inside the SoE ship.
'''Blitz''':Use a fast frigate or interceptor. Pick up the diplomat in P1. Return to the warp in, drop them off, and warp away. Mission is complete.
'''Eliminating the Navy Ships''': Instead of returning to the entrance start point immediately, you can go get your ship of choice to kill all enemies at the warp-in point. Simply ensure you transfer
the rescued diplomat into your combat ship's cargohold. Upon returning to the warp-in/mission entrance you can kill everything with your large ship and deposit the diplomat.

Unknown (Minmatar?) loot = approx 11.9 Mil ISK if you salvage everything
No faction standings losses are incurred for completing this mission for either full clear or blitz.

en: You warp in to an empty pocket but soon find yourself surrounded by a swarm of Hostiles.
Group spawn is slightly delayed and distances vary. The spawn order is group 4, 2, 1 and then 3 and 5.
Group 1 will auto aggro after some time.
Proximity aggro is a major factor in this mission. Please be aware that you can aggro a neutral group by just moving too close to it.
The proximity distance for Group 4 is about 80km. It is recommended that you do not move your ship.
All other groups remain neutral until attacked or approached.
Attacking group 1 does not aggro any other groups.
Attacking group 2 will aggro group 3 (and vice-versa).
Attacking group 4 will aggro group 5 (and vice-versa).
To throw off aggro from group 5, wait until an enemy ship from group 5 has locked your ship. Warp out, then warp back in.
If you have to move be careful not to approach the neutral groups, move up or down as you are surrounded from the sides.
Recommended order of elimination : Group 1, 5 (if you do not warp out to throw-off aggro), 4, 2 and 3.
Except Gist Saint and the Battlecruiser, the Battleships are all coming in range of 5- 8 km. Great for salvaging afterwards.
Eliminate all ships from Group 5 and warp out.

Sniped all Hostiles from the Beacon in order of proximity, from nearest to farthest. Easily done in a T2 fit Dominix with T2 Bouncer, ~620 DPS, 112hp/s rep. Did not get scrammed. However, this approach is not always feasible.
At warp-in, you will see Group 4. Four other groups will spawn several seconds later.
The spawn order is Group 2, Group 1, Group 3 and finally Group 5.
It is recommended that you DO NOT MOVE your ship.
The proximity aggro bubble for Group 4 is about 80km and you may get aggroed EITHER during warp-in or if you move towards it.
Groups 2, 3, 4 & 5 will remain neutral until attacked or aggroed via proximity.
''As of 11-08-2014 Group 5 stopped Auto-aggroing and follows same rules as Groups 2, 3 & 4''
The two Loyal elite frigates in Group 1 will frequently warp scramble you in under 20 secs.
Attacking Group 1 does not aggro any other groups. You can safely deploy drones to attack this group.
Attacking Group 2 aggros Group 3 (and vice versa). You can safely deploy drones after the pair have been aggroed.
Attacking Group 4 aggros Group 5 (attacking Group 5 didn't aggro group 4). You can safely deploy drones after the pair have been aggroed.
Group 4 may aggro drones if they get too close to that group.
Throw off aggro from Group 5 : Wait until an enemy ship from Group 5 have locked your ship. Warp out, then warp back in. No longer needed, doesn't auto-aggro.
Be absolutely careful not to move towards the neutral groups. Move away from them to minimize setting off the proximity aggro.
Recommended order of elimination : Group 1, Group 5 (if you do not warp out to throw-off aggro) & Group 4, finally Group 2 & Group 3.
Mission is flagged completed when ALL ships in Group 5 are killed.

There are 3 rooms in this mission that have a basic structure of 2 gates 1 active that leads to a guard room and 1 inactive that leads to the next room. Kill all the spawns in the room for a key to drop take that to the guard room and kill all the spawns there for the guard post to appear, drop the key in the guard post for the inactive gate to become active. This works for the first room but it does not work for the second or third room.

Since you can warp to anywhere in the mission grab a fast ship, align yourself with the gate and travel 10,000km to get to the room, bookmark and come back with a fleet. With a 5 km/s cepter it took roughly 30 minutes to travel to the next room. This won’t work for the second broken gate as the inactive gate is also facing the wrong direction (it’s instead facing the same way as the guard post so if you try and travel you’ll just end up at the guard post) the real direction is roughly 90 degrees to the left of where it is pointing which is very hard to get to if you try to align yourself with that gate.

Waves deal all kinds of damage evenly and occur at 5, 25, 45, 65, 95, 115, 135, 155, 175, and 205 seconds after the initial damage.
Every wave has 4 separate damage types.
Total unresisted damage starts at about 200 (50 per type) and slightly goes up to about 1400 (350 per type).
The final wave will be more than 4000 (more than 1000 per type) unresisted damage.
See the full breakdown in the comments.
The solution for the average level 2 mission runner is obviously not to get hit by the final wave.

Damage dealt: Thermal (41%)/ Kinetic (24%)/ EM (21%)/ Explosive (14%)
Recommended ship class: T2/ T3 Cruiser and higher or a fast Frigate to blitz.

The 1st ambush spawn is triggered when the Mining Corporation Headquarters station is attacked OR when your ship is within 10km from locked acceleration gate.
The 2nd ambush spawn is triggered when your ship is within 10km from locked acceleration gate.
To manage aggro, trigger the first ambush by attacking the Mining Corporation Headquarters station.
The mission is flagged completed once you have triggered both spawns, by either approaching to within 10km of the acceleration gate or destroying the station.
The Mining Corporation Headquarters has very high HP (~306,550) and drops mainly T1 modules and some Faction ammo.
There are no NPC ships to kill. The warp gate is 60km away from the warp-in point. The gate is configured to reject Capsules and Capitals.

The toxic environment will damage your ship in consecutive toxic cloud waves. Each wave deals an equal amount of each type of raw damage with no resists applied. Damage amount increases with each successive wave.
After the final giant toxic cloud wave there will be no more damage coming from the toxic environment.
The toxic cloud waves will be reset after you have warped out.

The waves take 4:00 min, if you warp back shortly after the final wave, they don't reset and you can fly to the gate unmolested. If you come back too fast they are still going and you can die. If you wait too long or if someone else warps in, the wave sequence may reset.

The way to do this safely is to start a 4 minute timer as you start to warp, then warp out as soon as you land (about half the time a Shuttle can make it out), re-dock and get a new shuttle if needed, when the 4 minutes is up, warp in, fly to the gate.
Fly to the gate in a small fast ship or micro jump a Battleship or Battlecruiser to trigger the ambush, align and warp out as soon as the mission completes.
The Mercenary Wingman frigates will spawn on top of the warp gate. You may get webbed/ scrambled if you're not fast enough in warping out.
Fit an omni-tank with a minimum sustainable 200 ehp per damage type.
Fit a Microwarpdrive (or afterburner) to quickly cover the distance to the warp gate to save time and if your tank does not meet the minimum requirement.
If you're in a slow battleship fit a Micro Jump Drive, align to the gate and jump, you'll only have to fly about 15km this way.

steps: Angel, camera 1: omori tot. Poarta e la 28 km și se deblochează doar după ce mor toate navele.

This is a perfect mission to farm

You warp in between sentry guns and a EM forcefield, with a small group of cruisers and a battleship firing at you. Get past the sentries, and take them out. Then the aggroing group.
There are two more groups, but they might seem a bit mixed. Fire at one rat and get aggro from one group at a time.

If you get aggro from everything, and you are not tanked vs kin, make sure you take out the named rat, as he deals a lot of damage. Had to use two repairers to keep up first time I tried this mission.
Chief Rat: Faramon Mundan: DPS: 230.20hp/s (EM: 85hp/s, Expl: 0hp/s, Kin: 43.20hp/s, Therm: 102hp/s) + Wrath cruise missile.

Other than that it should be safe to deploy drones in all pockets.

Rachen Mysuna has a 50km orbit range and 75% chance for shield boost (1000hp each 10 seconds) so low SP BS pilots can have problems breaking his tank. Rachen's 25% chance for defender doesn't help either. If you are a Raven pilot and can't handle it from distance, warp out and warp in again, then get closer (afterburner can help) and wait until he starts shooting you. Loot can be quite good (like Arbalest Cruise + Siege, named 350mm Railgun etc.).

To be honest, I heard a few times that it isn't possible to kill Mysuna without Torps. :) Well I personally finished him from 50km using T1 Wrath Cruise Missiles, without drones. All depends on skills and equipment. If you're droning be aware that he is VERY resistant to thermal. Wasps or even Wardens are preferable to Gardes and Ogres.

Rachen Mysuna is easier to kill when webbed to slow down. Was able to take her out with a heavy missile t1 drake once a friend put 2 webs on her and slowed the speed down to 40; took less than 12 volleys then. Without the speed her tank dies quickly under scourge heavy missiles (xr-3200 launchers too) (10/15/11)
Guristas War Installation drops rubbish loot (like 100 Light Missiles, Small NOS, 250mm T1 Railgun and Malkuth Rocket launcher).
Blitz No real blitz must clear first 2 pockets to proceed into 3rd room

I did the mission while flying a HAMGu (Heavy Assault Missle Tengu), I directly burned towards Rachen and orbitted at 7500m he couldnt hit me and since it was the first target i did not have any problems with an insane tank. So it might be that his tank gets triggered after you kill something else first. Mind it was a t2 fitted hamgu, only high meta item was the AB. It might be that you get webbed by the frigs while burning towards him, just dispatch them. It was easier than i expected.

Recommended order of elimination : Group 1 & 5, Group 2 and Group 3 & 4.

NOTE: I notice since the AI update the ships react to the type of drones you use. While using long range sentry drones the foes try to get out of the drones ranges by getting closer. While using short range sentry drones the foes try to move away.
The NPC ships will not travel more than 30km from their respective spawn points.

Move to a sniping position near the respective gate, roughly 75-80km (recommended distance) from the Angel Asteroid Outpost or Sansha Watchtower. They will travel back and forth in a merry-go-round while you snipe.
On warp-in, Group 1 will auto aggro. The Angel Spy frigates do not scramble but they do web. DO watch for Thugs and Outlaws srcams. All ships in this pocket have to be destroyed to unlock the gate.

DO NOT deploy your drones to attack Group 1. (I'm going to say this is optional. I didn't move and I had my drones attack group 1 with no problem. However, everyone in the room did target my drones and not me. T1 hobgoblin)
Any attack on the Angel Spy frigates by fleet members will aggro the entire pocket. It is safe however, for them to kill the sentry guns in Group 1.
The FIRST ship that had warped into the pocket may kill the Angel Spy frigates without repercussions, as long as you stick to turret weapons/missiles.
NO aggro from the other groups until you attack them. Each group can be aggroed independently.

Once Group 1 has been eliminated, it is fairly safe to deploy your drones for the remaining groups. Keep a close watch on your drones’ target to ensure that they do not stray and mistakenly attack a neutral group.
Recommended order for elimination : Group 1, Group 2, Group 3 and finally Group 4.

You will warp-in randomly around 5km from the Heron. In addition to the immediate aggro from Group 1, there is a small chance that one or more other groups will aggro due to proximity triggers.
If this happens, start moving away from the remaining neutral groups and check if the webbing/scrambling Elite Frigates have you locked. Kill them first if they have you locked.
If you are fleeted with friends, have them focus fire on Group 1 or any groups that have been aggroed by mistake.

The FIRST ship needs to act as an Fleet Commander and assign the appropiate targets. A common mistake is to have everyone shoot random or their closest target, which leads to the whole pocket being aggroed.

Sometimes fleet members that enter later will land differently and aggro groups that were unaggroed. If this includes the elite frigates and they scramble the new arrival, it can mean a quick death. All fleet members should have at least enough tank to survive until the scramblers are cleared. Having the lead ship tank the entire pocket is extremely difficult, as it can put down 1300-1500 dps, in a wide variety of configurations. Here are some (extreme) examples:
NO drone aggro for the entire pocket. You can deploy drones normally.
Warping-in from either Angel or Sansha Base does not change the ship combination for this pocket. It will always be Angel ships.
Pocket 1 : Unlock the Angel Base gate either using a Zbikoki's Hacker Card (or killing the Gist War General). The card will be consumed upon activation.
Pocket 2 (Angel Base): All ships in Pocket 2 have to be destroyed to unlock the gate.
Pocket 3 (Research Outpost): Destroy Group 1, grab the hostages from the heron, fly back to your agent. No need to destroy entire groups. - confirmed in July 16, 2014.
The Zbikoki's Hacker Card can be found in Zor's wreck in “The Right Hand of Zazzmatazz” or "Damsel In Distress" Level 4 mission.

This is not a drone friendly mission. However, one thing I notice since the AI update is a "glitch". If you do not shoot anyone, and you release more than one drone shooting at one target. Once they start shooting at one of your drones you can scoop that drone back into the bay. The foes should not shoot at your other drones. This "glitch" maybe fixed down the road.

en: You arrive in the middle of two large groups (135km to the nearest rat) and two gates (40km to each gate approx). One for your primary enemy, and one for the faction mentioned in the mission briefing (in this case, Blood Raiders and Angels). They start far away from you behind their own gate. The gates are locked until you kill the last ship of that faction. But, you can unlock them by carrying Zbikoki's Hacker Card (obtained from Zor) in your cargohold. It will be consumed on activation.

If you can't build a strong enough omni-tank based on the information provided, I'd suggest tanking EM/TH first and take the mission to completion, and then come back with your Angel Cartel tank before turning the mission in.

Both Groups are "anchored" to within about 30km of their start locations, which are about 85 to 95 km behind their gate. This makes it easy to snipe them from the far edge of the gate if you can lock and hit from that far out. Neither group can hit you from 55km.

Warning: if you do it all wrong and aggro all of them --

Drones can be safely used to kill the auto-aggro group. Just make sure they don't shoot Spies.
One can slowboat to the next gate. No additional aggro. You will be at around 5 km to the gate when the gate group aggros you.

Wait for the 1st group to target you, and take them all out. Fire on another ship, it's group will target you, and take that group out. Feel free to take out the Blood Spy's, once the 2nd group is gone, to trigger the last group.
you might find a collidable structure in your way (or even hit it) as you enter.

Using drones on the Spies causes the whole room to aggro.
The Saints throw Bane torpedoes and can hit at 55km or more.
Arch Gistum Centurion is fast and will close the range to under 20km, so kill before the Saints.
Cherubim throw Havoc cruise missiles to at least 80km. Thrones are shorter range.

Chance of spawning a Gist Overlord [543k battleship] as well. Chance increases with every ship that enters the room. Overlord waits to be attacked, and attacking it caused the remainder of the room to aggro.
Untested: A second ship (gangmate) present may cause entire room to aggro immediately.
Original player leaving to get more ammo and returning does not cause remaining groups to aggro.

s: Elder Corpum Dark Priest / Elder Corpum Shadow Sage
Corpus Apostle / Corpus Oracle / Coprus Prophet
Elder Corpii Herald / Dark Corpii Upholder
Coprus Apostle / Coprus Oracle / Coprus Prophet

en: VIP: Killing all the ships in the 3rd pocket trips the "mission completed" flag even IF you do NOT pick up the stranded crew. *
{Ie: If you kill them all, and fail to pick up the crew, you will have to quit the mission with loss of standings from agent, corp, and faction.}
The pocket looks like a single group, but it's actually 3. Use the same technique suggested for the Blood Raider pocket.
They won't move very fast, so you can get some range on them if you can find a direction to go that doesn't come close to other groups.
Again, if you do everything wrong [use drones, etc.]
Full-aggro is 900-950dps (EM 51%/TH 49%) with the occasional kinetic cruise missile from the BS's.
Only need to blow up the auto-aggro group to get the ship crew.
Keep drones on Passive to prevent any unwanted aggro

On occasion, you might - even without drones or partners - aggro all of the groups (some of which can warp scramble). I suggest you put some distance fast between u and the groups you haven't yet aggroed.

s: Federation Navy Gamma I Support Frigate

en: Each gate is locked until you kill a trigger from each group. Gates can, however, be activated, before killing the trigger, by using a Zbikoki's Hacker Card.
Groups aggro individually and will not fly further than ~30km from their control towers.

Strongly recommend using Thermal missiles against the Federation Navy Orion, even if you're flying a Drake or Tengu, as they'll deal 2x the damage, even after the 25% damage bonus from the hull / offensive subsystem is taken into account.

s: Federation Navy Delta II Support Frigate
Centus Dread Lord/Savage Lord/Dark Lord/Beast Lord
Centus Savage Lord/Plague Lord/Mutant Lord/Slave Lord

en: note: if anything (except the frigates target) engage web frigates, the hole pocket attack that target and then you. So the engaged target have to kill web frigates with their guns/missiles.
Groups aggro when engaged or on proximity. Initial auto-aggro will vary, depending on which group you land closest to.
Pocket 1: Approach the Sansha gate kill the triggers or use Zbikoki's Hacker Card to jump in. (the card is consumed in process)

Pocket 2: Kill web frigates with your guns/missiles then approach the acceleration gate (be sure that you don't go near group 2 or group 3 in order to do that go to smaller end of acceleration gate) and use it.
Pocket 3: Kill all Ships. (sometimes the cargo is unlocked before you kill all ships)
You can blitz this by using Zbikoki's Hacker Card. (Obtained from Zor in other missions). It will be consumed upon unlocking the gate.
Drones steal aggro sometimes in Serpentis group. Probably due to range. That never happened to me for the Gurista group though.
non-ganged logistical ships seem to not get aggro. Cloak outside of the clouds between the 2 groups to be safe.

Tip: if you go from the clouds of Guristas group to the Serpentis group and stop 74k ish from the gate of the Serpentis group only the BS will shoot you. all the rest will be out of range and never get close enough due to some kinda mission setting to stop them going too far from the gate.
Tip2: Both groups have a bunker in the middle of the clouds that they are tied to at around 40km. If they reach that mark they turn back and burn it to the bunker.
For missile spammers: I usualy start from killing BS in aggroing group, because its faster (Serpentis BS have a lot of defenders, from small distance they can't pop your missiles). Drones aggro.

For Tengus and other speedtanks: kill frigates from the first group, then the spies,then other ships (or when u are confident on your tank holding entire pocket (and don't want to switch ammo) kill all frigates first.

If you move towards the groups of ships or your drones move close to them you get aggro from them by proximity. Your drones will also draw aggro from every unaggressed ship in the pocket if they attack the Angel Spies, but enemies will deaggro upon recalling your drones to the drone bay.
non-ganged logistical ships seem to not get aggro. Up is a good direction to go.

s: Guristas Overseer) (BS, Always spawn spawns very occasionally, can drop faction loot

en: Guristas Spy (25k and 30k frigates) webbing, drones can aggro, same applies for group 4 - the Kyoukan will sometimes attack your drones.
Killing this group will unlock the Heron cargohold
Gate in this room is now also locked, its not possible to warp to first room again until you clear all enemies (Date of test September 5th 2012).
Edit: Gate is no longer unlocked, date of test September 5th 2012. Same applies to all other gates except the Warzone gates.
Old text: just kill the Guardian Veterans webbing you, then warp to The Research Outpost.

Alternative Blitz: warp in tanked decoy alt first, so you will not be webbed when warping in your main. This requires two Zbikoki's cards, if combined with the blitz for stage 1, but saves you another minute or so taking down the Guardian Veterans.
None, gate is locked, kill all the ships in this stage to jump to the Research Outpost.
non-ganged logistical ships seem to not get aggro. Up is a good direction to go.
Salvagers Note: ( Items in Italics needs to be confirmed )

Reports of a random BS spawn are now no longer true - the BS which used to spawn chance based before is now renamed to "Supervisor" and always there at start. Be advised when solo salvaging. The ship is the Overseer. It has about a 50% chance of physically being in the room in the beggining and another 50% chance of not coming in until a un-determined amount of time.

Choose one of two groups, kill them (you only need to kill the battleships) and go deeper using appropriate warpgate into second pocket (Serpentis base or Gurista base). From both second pockets route is directly to third pocket which is always same (Research outpost).

s: Dire Pithum Eraser/ Dire Pithum Abolisher

en: You arrive at distance from two large groups (Serpentis and Guristas) guarding their respective gates. The gates are locked until you kill the last ship (see blitz).
The Guristas (Pith) ships will aggro your drones after a while.
The ships are sitting at a ~100km away from their gates, best to have some long range sniper ship or a fast one.
Gate to Serpentis Base is at 29km.
Gate to Guristas Base is at 26km.

s: Core Rear Admiral/ Core Flotilla Admiral
Core Rear Admiral/ Core Port Admiral

en: Aggro at warp-in from one group. 4 Groups total.
All pretty close and can apply a lot of DPS if full room aggro occurs (which happens sometimes on warp-in).
Guardian Veterans may web and scramble. Battleships in all groups. And there's two Angel spies in the pocket.
Gate to the Research Outpost is at 21km.
The Serprentis Stonghold has a lot of HP and drops assorted ammo and modules (not worth the time).

s: Pith Eliminator/ Exterminator/ Massacrer/ Ursuper/ Extinguisher

en: Gate to the Research Outpost is at 21km.
Distribution within the 3 groups not yet perfect. Haven't had time to sit back, relax and write it all down perfectly. Will do shortly.
Aggro from one. For me when I did shoot group 3, group 2 did aggro as well. A single Sansha's Demon is also spotted.
The ships will aggro other Fleet Members when they arrive.

n.en: Research Outpost (Common 2nd Pocket with Damaged Heron)

s: Core Rear Admiral/ Vice Admiral/ Flotilla Admiral

en: Warp in beacon is in the middle of 4 groups. Great for short range weapons. No web/ scramblers. Aggro from one group.
If you shoot only the aggro Group, you won't get stage aggro. After finishing the first group take an NPC near the gate and you will get aggro from the next group and so on.
There's a damaged Heron in the middle as a spawn container. Open it, and loot 20 "Ship's Crew" when you have destroyed close to everything.
Gate to the Warzone leads back to the warp in area, the Warzone Stage.

The Overseer is a special ship [Dominix] that rarely spawn in the 1st room. It has, in its description: "Sometimes they hire a good pilot to fly their ships" and has a value between 487K and 4.8 mil. The higher value one has a MWD (moves at ~600m/s), but has low resists and doesn't aggro until you shoot it. It drops faction loot with a low possibility of a Serpentis Blueprint. It's spawn point is with the group that does not aggro at the beginning of the stage.
Warp through the Guristas Acceleration Gate using Zbikoki's Hacker Card (obtained from Zor in the 'Right Hand of Zazzmatazz' mission). It will be consumed on activation.
Kill the 4 battleships to unlock gate. Kill Group 1 (spawns first) to "unlock" the Heron. It consists of 3 Battleships and 3 Battlecruisers.
When the last ship is destroyed, you can loot the crew from the Heron and leave.
None of the other groups that spawn soon afterwards aggro, and neither do they object to drones.
Sniper [Sentry] fit with MJD. Snipe from warp in beacon in first pocket, best to Micro Jump right away to snipe in all other pockets unless heavily tanked.
Due to drone aggro, the use of Heavy Drones is not recommended.

guide.obj: Salvezi echipajul (item de 40 m³) din camera finală: omori primul grup, iei echipajul din nava avariată și îl duci la agent.
guide.rooms: 3: zona de intrare, baza uneia dintre cele două facțiuni, camera finală
steps: Camera 1: două grupuri, fiecare cu poarta lui blocată. Deblochezi poarta omorând trigger-ul grupului: Federation Navy Orion la Gallente, Centus Savage Lord la Sansha. Pe poarta Sansha ajungi cel mai repede.
Grupurile nu se îndepărtează la mai mult de 30 km de turnurile lor, deci le poți lua pe rând.
Camera 2: omori frigatele care te web-uiesc, apoi intri pe poartă fără să te apropii de celelalte grupuri.
Camera 3: omori toate navele. Containerul cu obiectivul se deblochează, uneori chiar mai devreme.
notes: Pe Federation Navy Orion, rachetele thermal fac cam dublu damage.
Frigatele elite fac warp disruption și web. Omoară-le primele.

en: The only difference to Fate Of Angels is not to blow up the battlestation, but the drug lab.

Beware. this guide is somewhat out of date as of 7-16-09 when you warp in there are the correct amount of towers but the mission contains all battlecrusiers intially then five minutes in spawns 5 more battle crusiers and three battleships. For a total of something like 25 BC 3 BS.

The layout of the groups that cause spawns from fate of angels is correct but only one group caused a spawn and not both. As to which I am not sure. but the spawn was 3 frigates and 3 battleships again.
The spawns for the energy neutralizer and the repair stations are correct.
Will fix the guide next time I pull the mission if someone else does not already. I figured that the changes were drastic enough to post in the guide and not on comments so its more noticeable.

guide.obj: Îl găsești pe Dr. Fajah Ateshi (1 m³) și îl duci la agent.
guide.rooms: 2: zona de intrare și camera cu The Anomaly
steps: Camera 1: lângă intrare plutesc 5 life pod-uri. Fă Show Info pe fiecare. Cel corect are descrierea „A life pod from a long since destroyed ship” și e de obicei cel mai sus pe verticală.
Apropie-te de el. Apare un container. Deschide-l și mută Oura Madusaari în cargo.
Mergi la poarta de accelerare. Poarta merge doar dacă ai Oura Madusaari în cargo.

Camera 2: The Anomaly e o Orca blocată într-o gaură de vierme care nu funcționează. Lângă ea sunt mai multe Pressure Silo. Sub ~5 km de The Anomaly un nor te lovește periodic cu EM (cam 5 lovituri de 200–400).
Lock pe Pressure Silo-ul cel mai apropiat de The Anomaly și distruge-l. Apare The Paryi cu un container.
Ia-l pe Dr. Fajah Ateshi din container (merge și cu tractor beam-ul de la distanță) și du-l la agent.
notes: Fără nave inamice. Singurul damage vine de la norul EM și de la exploziile silozurilor.
Un siloz care explodează face ~800 damage în jur. Nu folosi drone pe silozuri și nu sta lipit de ele.
Oura Madusaari nu se consumă. Ține-o în cargo: data viitoare sari direct la poartă.

guide.obj: Duci Neurowave Pattern Scanner (0 m³) în cargo-ul navei The Anomaly.
steps: Când accepți misiunea, agentul pune Neurowave Pattern Scanner în item hangar. Mută-l în cargo înainte de undock. Ocupă 0 m³.
Warp la misiune. The Anomaly e la ~29 km, în spatele punctului de intrare. Întoarce camera ca s-o vezi.
Dă Approach pe The Anomaly. Pornește afterburner/MWD dacă ai.
Pe drum apare o Amarr Cruise Missile Battery care trage în tine. Nu trebuie distrusă. Când te apropii destul se oprește singură și primești un popup.
Sub ~10 km de The Anomaly începe norul EM: întâi 4 lovituri de ~175, apoi 4 de ~300 și 4 de ~450 pe măsură ce te apropii. Ține shield booster-ul pornit și nu te opri.
Când ești sub 2,5 km: click dreapta pe The Anomaly → Open Cargo și trage scanner-ul din cargo-ul tău în al ei.
Misiunea se termină pe loc și The Anomaly face warp. Pleacă și raportează la agent.
notes: Nu există nave inamice. Un hardener EM sau multispec și shield booster-ul sunt suficiente.
Nu intra în Bastion: nu ai ce omorî și te blochează pe loc în nor.

guide.obj: Pui Dr. Fajah Ateshi (1 m³) în containerul navei Rogue Drone de lângă The Anomaly.
guide.rooms: 2: o cameră de luptă și camera cu The Anomaly
steps: Mută Dr. Fajah Ateshi din item hangar în cargo înainte de undock.
Camera 1: grupul de 2 battleship-uri de la ~30 km atacă imediat. Atacul pe orice alt grup trage toată camera după tine.
Poarta apare când mor cele 2 battlecruisere Striker Alvatis din grupul 2 (~40 km). Poți ignora restul.
Grupul 3 (~35 km) are Strain Render Alvi care te ține cu warp disruptor și web. Cât ești disruptat nu poți folosi poarta, deci omoară frigatele astea dacă te prind.
Camera 2: The Anomaly e la ~50 km de intrare, iar nava Rogue Drone e la câțiva km după ea. La ~5 km de intrare stau câteva frigate și un battlecruiser.
Nu trage în frigatele care nu au web/scram: atacul pe ele cheamă întăririle de la ~50 km (două grupuri, stânga și dreapta, care se activează și la proximitate ~30 km).
Dă Approach direct pe nava Rogue Drone, cu afterburner/MWD dacă ai.
Sub 2,5 km: click dreapta pe nava Rogue Drone → Open Cargo și pune Dr. Fajah Ateshi în ea. Misiunea se termină și The Anomaly e distrusă după câteva secunde.
notes: Nu-l pune pe Dr. Fajah Ateshi în The Anomaly: Orca sare cu el la bord. Containerul corect e cel al navei Rogue Drone.
Dronele fac exploziv, kinetic și termic. Trage cu EM sau termic.
Strain Render Alvi au web și warp disruptor. Ține-le la distanță sau omoară-le primele.
Dronele neagresate trag totuși în dronele tale.
Pentru partea asta nu am găsit detalii sigure. Obiectivul exact îl vezi în jurnalul misiunii.
Într-una dintre primele două părți, obiectivul e distrugerea Broadcasting Array. Asta te costă aproximativ 2.4% standing.
Pentru partea asta nu am găsit detalii sigure. Obiectivul exact îl vezi în jurnalul misiunii.
Într-una dintre primele două părți, obiectivul e distrugerea Broadcasting Array. Asta te costă aproximativ 2.4% standing.

guide.obj: Iei 100 Freed Slaves (100 m³) din containerul care pică.
Iei un data chip dintr-o stație din Kulelen și îl duci la agent.

missions.name: In The Midst of Deadspace (2 of 5)

guide.obj: Duci cei 50 de marines la Alakgur VII – Moon 3 – Republic Security Services Assembly Plant.
Omori raiderii Mordu's Legion și recuperezi Encrypted Ship Log (1 m³).
Distrugi Caldari Supply Depot.
notes: Atacul pe depozit atrage apărătorii, iar apoi mai vin întăriri.
Dacă distrugi doar depozitul, nu pierzi standing Caldari.

guide.obj: Distrugi battlecruiser-ul Amarr avariat (Prophecy).
notes: Blitz: omori Prophecy și pleci. Când tragi în ea, aproape tot restul camerei te atacă.

guide.obj: Distrugi toate minele. Misiunea se termină când distrugi Amarrian Drone Mine 1, care apare după celelalte.
notes: Minele au ~1200 HP. Dacă o omori dintr-o singură salvă, nu mai lansează drone.
Fiecare mină distrusă te costă aproximativ 2.4% standing Amarr.
Pentru partea asta nu am găsit detalii sigure. Obiectivul exact îl vezi în jurnalul misiunii.
Una dintre părțile lanțului cere transportul a 100.000 Mexallon (1.000 m³).
Pentru partea asta nu am găsit detalii sigure. Obiectivul exact îl vezi în jurnalul misiunii.
Jucătorii o descriu ca asemănătoare cu partea 2, cu valuri care apar la interval fix.
E partea cea mai lungă a lanțului. Unii jucători raportează neuturi.
Pentru partea asta nu am găsit detalii sigure. Obiectivul exact îl vezi în jurnalul misiunii.

guide.obj: Declanșezi ambele ambuscade: te apropii la 10 km de poarta blocată (la ~72 km) sau ataci stația Mining Corporation Headquarters, apoi pleci.
notes: Mercenary Wingman apar pe poartă și te pot web-ui sau scrambla. Pleacă imediat ce se bifează.
Mercenarii de aici sunt slabi la EM pe shield și la explosive pe armor.

guide.obj: Ajungi la poarta de la ~60 km de punctul de intrare.
notes: Damage-ul vine pe timp, nu pe distanță: un nor toxic lovește în 11 valuri, în primele 4 minute de la sosire, cu damage egal pe EM, thermal, kinetic și explosive.
Valurile cresc de la 2.000 (la 0:15) la 3.800 (la 3:10), plus un val final de 8.000 la 4:00. În total ~40.000 damage, iar după valul final nu mai vine nimic.
Valurile se resetează dacă faci warp afară sau dacă intră altcineva. Truc: intri, faci warp afară imediat, aștepți 4 minute, apoi revii și zbori liniștit la poartă.

guide.obj: Distrugi slave pen-ul și iei cei 50 de prizonieri (375 m³) din container.
steps: Warp la misiune. Slave pen-ul e la ~40 km de intrare.
Grupul de la intrare atacă: 4 frigate elite cu web, 2 battlecruisere și 1 battleship. Le poți ignora sau omorî, după cum ți-e mai comod.
Distruge slave pen-ul. Prizonierii apar într-un container lângă el.
Mergi la container (sau trage-l cu tractor beam-ul) și mută cei 50 de prizonieri în cargo.
Warp afară și du-i la agent.
notes: După ~8–10 minute în misiune apare încă un battleship lângă beacon. Dacă termini repede, nu-l vezi.
Frigatele elite au web. Ține-le la distanță sau omoară-le primele dacă te prind.

guide.obj: Omori cele două Sansha Slaver (crucișătoare elite) din camera 2.
guide.rooms: 2: zona de intrare cu poarta și camera cu cele două Sansha Slaver
steps: Camera 1: grupul de la intrare (1 crucișător elite, 3 battlecruisere, 2 battleship-uri) atacă imediat și orbitează la ~15 km.
Omoară tot grupul. Poarta se deblochează doar după ce moare ultima navă.
Camera 2: multe ținte și DPS mare. Pe lângă nave sunt 2 Stasis Tower (web), 2 Sentry Gun, 4 Heavy Missile Battery și 2 Cruise Missile Battery.
Distruge întâi bateriile de rachete și battlecruiserele, ca să scazi damage-ul primit.
Omoară cele două Sansha Slaver. Misiunea se termină când mor amândouă, restul camerei poate rămâne.
notes: Frigatele elite au web și warp disruptor. Dacă ai probleme cu tank-ul, nu poți face warp afară cât te țin.
Heavy Missile Battery trag după mai multe nave odată. Intră în Bastion înainte să tragi în camera 2.

guide.obj: Distrugi Amarr Lookout.

notes: Pentru partea asta nu am găsit detalii sigure. Obiectivul exact îl vezi în jurnalul misiunii.

guide.obj: Omori toți inamicii.
notes: Nu se poate blitz-ui.

guide.obj: Transporți 25 Deep Cover Corporate Assassin (7.500 m³).
Oprești minatul ilegal al Federației.
steps: Distrugi Mobile Refinery. Minerii nu trebuie omorâți.

guide.obj: Lanț de 9 părți, cu luptă și câteva transporturi mici între ele.
Transporți 25 Herd of Conditioned House Slaves (7.500 m³).

en: Upon activating the acceleration gate to the room.
The acceleration gate to the second room is locked and requires Thorak’s Private Key. The key is in Thorak's Biodome Garden.
Thorak's Biodome Garden: Thorak’s Private Key and 1st Tier Overseer's Personal Effects.
Acceleration Gate: Requires Thorak's Private Key. It is consumed on use.
Upon activating the acceleration gate to the room.

A major blow was dealt to an otherwise successful energy pooling operation when a meteor shower pummeled the control bridge to pieces. Reports indicate that Orfus, the CEO of the the self-titled galactic repair corporation, agreed to fix it for the troubled energy contractor in return for huge stakes in the eventual profits.
Oofus's Repair Shop: 2nd Tier Overseer's Personal Effects and may contain Gistii C-type modules, Angel Cartel faction modules or a Dramiel BPC.
Minmatar Contracted Bio-Farm is a DED Rated Complex. It can be found by scanning cosmic signatures in Minmatar high security space.
The entry to this site is limited to T2 and Faction frigates and below.
This is a two room complex.

lootList: 1st Tier Overseer's Personal Effects · 11k ISK · Thorak's Biodome Garden · 100% drop rate
2nd Tier Overseer's Personal Effects · 20k ISK · Oofus's Repair Shop · 100% drop rate

Domination Frigate Modules · Oofus's Repair Shop
Dramiel BPC · Oofus's Repair Shop

guide.obj: Omori tot până la ultima cameră și iei loot-ul de la Overseer.
notes: Doar fregate. Merge cu o fregată ieftină (de exemplu Kestrel), dar loot-ul e mic.
Loot: Overseer's Effects de câteva zeci de mii ISK, plus șansă la module Gistii C-Type și Domination de fregată.

en: The acceleration gate is locked and requires key for operating it. The key is found in the wreck of Deadspace Synchronization HQ.
Deadspace Synchronization HQ: Key for the acceleration gate. 3th Tier Overseer's Personal Effects. May contain Domination Items.
The acceleration gate to next room is locked and requires key. The key is found in the wreck of CreoCorp Main Factory.
CreoCorp Main Factory: Key for the acceleration gate. 4th Tier Overseer's Personal Effects. May contain Domination items.
Tools and Parts (1): Has Fast regenerating shield, but armor and structure are very weak; T1 Ammo.
Tools and Parts (2): Has Fast regenerating shield, but armor and structure are very weak; T1 Ammo.
Asteroid Colony Tower: Drops no loot. Very high (10K) armor and obscene (50k) structure HP
Deadspace Control Station: 5th Tier Overseer's Personal Effects. May contain Gistii B-type Modules and/or a rare Dramiel BPC.
Angel Creo-Corp Mining is a DED Complex (rated 2/10), occupied by the Angel Cartel pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Highsec systems.
This site's acceleration gate allows only destroyer class ships including tech 2 and tech 3 destroyers.

This site is doable in a beam-laser-fit Punisher with good piloting, but destroyers are recommended due to high number of ships. Pirate Frigates will have no problems with this site, and a Tactical Destroyer will make this site laughably easy. Avoid using Amarr ships as they deal EM and Thermal damage, the strongest resists of the Angel rats.

lootList: 4th Tier Overseer's Personal Effects · 60k ISK · CreoCorp Main Factory · 100% drop rate
Domination module · Deadspace Synchronization HQ
Domination modules · Creo-Corp Main Factory
Gistii B-type Modules · Deadspace Control Station · Up to 3x
Blueprint · Deadspace Control Station

notes: Maximum destroyere. Merge cu un destroyer ieftin (de exemplu Corax), dar loot-ul e mic.
Loot: Overseer's Effects ~60k, plus șansă la module Gistii B-Type și Domination.

en: That's better. My analysis shows there are three more pockets in this complex. The last pocket should contain a Domination Grigori. Eliminating this ship should severely ruin the Cartel's day.
The sentry guns do not aggress until you enter within very close proximity.
Domination Grigori: Domination or Gistii A-Type modules, and a possible Dramiel BPC
Angel Repurposed Outpost is a cosmic signature that can be found during exploration in high-security systems. thumb|Screenshot of max allowed ship sizes.
The ships in the 4th and 5th pockets can be aggroed a couple of groups at a time, but in the earlier pockets they all seem to aggro together.

A Domination Grigori is sent with a small frigate wing to clear out a minor smuggler outpost. Once temporary fortifications are made, the location is further masked with a series of interference broadcasts designed to confound Republic sensors.

guide.obj: Omori Domination Grigori și iei loot-ul din wreck.
notes: Loot: Overseer's Effects ~600k, plus șansă la module Gistii A-Type (27–100M), BPC de Daredevil (~40M) și module Domination.

en: I'm reading the presence of a Domination Excavator. Prepare yourself for a fight. Scientists or not, the Cartel only fields warships.

The entire pocket will auto-aggro in a few seconds, and the combined DPS is quite high. Well-tanked battlecruiser or pirate faction/heavy assault cruiser is advised. The Domination Excavator is marked with a battlecruiser icon but is an Overseer Cruiser. It has a fairly strong active tank which requires at least 250-300 Explosive DPS to safely break. Medium and heavy drones have no fun in this pocket as the rats tend to switch to attacking them in swarms and killing them quickly with high burst DPS.

Domination Excavator: Shield tank requires about 200-300 DPS to break; Contains 8th Tier Overseers effects, May also contain Gistum C-Type Modules or Domination Modules. May also contain a Cynabal BPC.

The Angel Cartel Occupied Mining Colony is a Cosmic Signature of the DED Complex (rated 4/10) type, occupied by the Angel Cartel pirate faction. It can be found via exploration by probing in Highsec and Lowsec systems.
This site's acceleration gate allows only Battlecruiser class ships or lower and their Tech 2 equivalents to enter the site.
(Note - Tech 3 cruisers are not supported by the entrance gate)

The Angel Cartel takes an unorthodox approach to these colonies, imprisoning the miners and replacing them with their own excavation teams, led by a Domination Excavator. The CDIA has yet to determine what the Cartel is after, though no significant amount of traditionally valuable ore has been taken.

lootList: 8th Tier Overseers Effects · 1.2m Isk · Domination Excavator · 100% drop rate
Domination Modules · Domination Excavator

en: The gate is unlocked and the rats do not need to be killed. But you will most likely have to fly through this pocket many times so thinning out the rats is recommended.
In the room there are twelve acceleration gates. One of them leads deeper into the complex while the rest loop back. Take the bottom gate.

Experienced explorers will quickly establish a simple method to always choose the correct acceleration gate. Before taking any gate, drop a canister in front of it. If the gate returns you to the entrance, proceed to the next gate you wish to try and drop a canister in front of that one. Label each can and proceed to continue with this process until you find the right gate - make a note of which can is in front of the proper gate and either ignore or destroy all of the others.

Each acceleration gate will first send you to an empty room and then back to the beginning of the complex. When you activate the second acceleration gate, you will instantly be able to tell whether or not you are being returned to the beginning - if you are, the intro window bearing the complex's description will pop up once again.
After successfully navigating the correct acceleration gate you arrive in the second room of The Maze. Once again you will be confronted by a group defending the area.
Once again you are faced with a choice of twelve acceleration gates, of which only one will lead further inside the complex. Take the fifth gate from the top
This time there are only four acceleration gates to choose from. Take the bottom gate.
This room comprises the smallest amount of defending NPCs so far. There is a total of 14 NPCs in this room; a mixture of Cruisers and Frigates.
You have to choose between two acceleration gates. Take the one on right side.

Each individual hit does upwards of 500k Kinetic damage, and while they have virtually zero application to subcapitals, they will still wreck your tank if you aren't moving constantly. The station itself doesn't have significant tank, with only 120k total HP and 288 DPS shield rep.

This room contains a mixture of frigates, cruisers, and battleships along with cruise missile batteries and the fleet outpost (firing Citadel Kinetic Torpedoes). Upon attacking the outpost 4 battleships spawn. The outpost will release more waves of defenders as it takes damage. Upon the outpost's destruction a jetcan will appear with a 23rd Tier Overseer's Personal Effects and possibly additional loot including Pith-X Type modules or a Rattlesnake BPC.

There are 4 additional spawns that occur at damage intervals on the station. A spawn will occur at half-shield, half-armor. two-thirds structure and one third structure. Once you have reduced the station to one third structure you may as well finish it off before dealing with the spawn. Database Entry for structure stats.

The damage in this room can exceed 600DPS if you are not careful; however, the room is mostly destroyers, and they only deal significant damage within 10km. The destroyers are also fairly squishy, so they die quickly, reducing room DPS.

If you are in a well-fit (t2 or equivalent) cruiser, you can safely ignore everything except the Centus Black Ops Commander. Quickly kill him, burn to his wreck, loot, and warp off. Only one heavy missile battery will aggro on warp-in, so the sentries will not be a major concern as long as you keep your distance.
As a T1 cruiser, you can launch a single light drone, make it shoot once in an overseer frigate, and scoop it back. This will trigger his aggro and lure him out of the group.
The Centus Black Ops Commander has high omni resists in shield(90% to all damage types) but is weak in armor and structure.

en: Full room aggro immediately after warp-in. You need to clear the entire pocket (minus the one sentry) to unlock the acceleration gate, which is ~45 km away.
The majority of the incoming DPS in this pocket comes from the battlecruisers and battleships, destroying them significantly reduces incoming damage, which can exceed 700 DPS.

Alternatively, you can keep the battleships at around 60-70 km and the battlecruisers at more than 40 km, the DPS is significantly reduced. Long-range weapons are recommended for this method. Smaller ships can simply destroy the cruiser and battlecruiser spawns, as the battleships' tracking is poor enough for a cruiser to speed-tank relatively easily.

Unlike other DED sites of this rating, the gate in this pocket is unlocked from the beginning. If your ship is fast and can field a strong tank of upwards of ~700 DPS EM/Thermal, you can simply cross the 40 km distance to the gate and skip the pocket entirely.

This pocket is the single most dangerous in the site. The triple stasis tower spawn will web you down to a standstill and make you an easy target for even the battleships to hit, even in fast moving cruisers. Additionally the weapons range of most of the battleships is very large and the smaller ships will close in quickly. Killing the stasis towers should be your highest priority, unless you can field at least 500 DPS/tank with over 80% EM/Thermal resists, in which then you can opt to immediately snipe the overseer. Once the towers die the rest of the fleet is significantly easier to speed-tank.

Note: The site has been known to despawn all NPCs except for the Phi-Operation Protector.

The Phi-Operation Protector battleship has a microwarpdrive, and will use it to close in on targets. On paper, its MWD can bring it up to 1000m/s, however in practice it usually will not exceed 850m/s. Its weapons are ineffective beyond around 30km, so if it can be outrun it should not be a major threat. Significantly, this battleship's armor has very high Kinetic resistance (80%) and it will actively repair itself. Its lowest resistance is Thermal (50%), which should be the damage used to kill it.

Core Admiral/Rear Admiral/Flotilla Admiral: Flotilla Admiral uses Remote Sensor Dampener

The initial damage is not high since most of the larger ships have limited damage projection, however due to the triple Stasis Tower webbing, they will close in quickly and apply extreme damage if the stasis towers aren't primaried. Alternatively, if you can project at least 500 DPS out to ~40-50 km, you can opt to immediately kill the Overseer, bookmark his wreck and come back to pick up the loot when the site despawns.
Sarpati Family Enforcer: 18th Tier Overseer's Personal Effects and a possibility of Corelum B-type/ Shadow Serpentis Modules and Vigilant BPC (rare)

The Serpentis Corporation Hydroponics Site is a DED complex found in Serpentis infested regions. In addition to being found in low sec by scanning this complex may be received as an escalation from a Serpentis Den. Medium Difficulty using T3 Cruiser, Combat Battlecruiser, Battleship (MJD).
Security forces should be mindful of any Sarpati family enforcers.

The damage can be overwhelming. However, in a cruiser sized ship, with a 100mn afterburner, you should be able to avoid most damage by orbiting a stationary target at around ~25km at ~900m/sec. Just make sure you target the rats which can hit you first, there should only be about 3-5 per pocket which can. However, this method becomes a bit difficult to execute due to the webs in the last room, so be wary. The webs practically make you a stationary target for the rats to shoot.
The names and amount of ships listed may vary slightly.

If you want to blitz the last pocket, head-shot the Sarpati Family Enforcer, bookmark their wreck, and warp out. Then come back by warping to the bookmark, since the gates will already have despawned, as will have all the remaining rats in the final room, and you can scoop the loot.

The Serpentis Logistical Outpost is combat signature that can be found in low-sec or null-sec, or as an escalation from completing the anomaly Serpentis Yard or Serpentis Rally Point. Technically the site is an unrated complex, but behaves like a DED 6/10 and thus can be considered the Serpentis DED 6/10.

The site is located behind an acceleration gate that allows T2 Battleships or lower to access and consists of two parts: Part 1 is found by probe scanning or as an escalation. Completing Part 1 will always cause an escalation to Part 2 at another location.
The Serpentis Logistical Outpost and Serpentis Logistical Outpost Part 2 are considered to be the hardest Serpentis Escalations.
Use extreme caution when completing the sites due to the Scramming Frigs and T2 Neuting Towers

Note: The Serpentis Prisoner Isolation Facility (the structure that contains your loot) has a very strong web and will immediately target you upon warp in. Be prepared to not be able to speed tank or move closer to the structure. Also of note is that it shoots XL Inferno torpedoes that do approx 2000 thermal damage, though their explosion radius is appropriate to the signature radius of capital ships so they apply little damage to battleships or smaller ships. The outpost also repairs itself to the tune of about 1000 DPS and has lots of structure hit points.

Incoming damage can be very high by reason of the Stasis Towers and the structure's web. Suggest refitting for maximum tank. Kill the webbing towers first, then the Elite Frigates, then move on to the rest. Profile is shown here: Database Entry

There is a glitch Last verified by Ageon Targaryeon on 15 January 2024 on this structure whereby the structure will stop repairing armor if it switches aggro. The structure's armor repair can be turned off by forcing it to switch its primary target (the target it fires torpedoes at and webs). A drone ship does this by having its drones out and attacking the structure, then flying over 120km away from it. Players in ships without drones will have to have ensure another pilot is in space within application range of the structure.

The site's signature will vanish once the last few rogue drones in the last pocket are defeated. Afterwards, leaving the site will result in the site despawning after a minute or so unless someone is present in the site. The site can very well despawn as you're warping back to it.

The first pocket has a sizable amount of Omber in one asteroid, the second pocket has two asteroids with low amounts and the final pocket has a mixed amount of high and low amounts of Omber in each asteroid.

If the site is present in Caldari space, it is recommended to use the Endurance or Venture to be able to defeat ECM rats with drones that can sporadically appear. The Endurance also boasts a larger mining hold to minimize ore drop-offs. In other empires, ECM is not a problem and the Prospect may be used as it can tank the rats through signature tanking and active tanking modules. The gate appears to accommodate Cruiser-sized ships, but mining barges and porpoises will not fit.

Rogue Drone Asteroid Infestation is a DED rated combat site found in high and low security space. It is often regarded as a low value site as it contains no faction drones and has a very low chance to drop a single faction module.
Interestingly, the site can have low amounts of Rogue Drone alloys in the cans in the last two pockets that can be reprocessed for minerals.

There are minable asteroids of Omber and Veldspar, but the site will despawn shortly after the drones guarding the Scratched Cask in the last room are defeated, preventing them from being mined unless someone stays in the site, although you do have enough time to go to a nearby station to drop off.
While mining the ore in the site, pirate rats (based on which empire space you're in) can randomly appear, their strength relative to the system's security rating.
